name: GuardDuty Publishing Destination Deletion
description: GuardDuty can publish findings to S3 or EventBridge. An attacker with guardduty:DeletePublishingDestination removes the publishing destination, stopping findings from reaching the SIEM or S3 bucket. guardduty:UpdatePublishingDestination can modify the destination to point elsewhere or disable it. Required permissions are guardduty:DeletePublishingDestination or guardduty:UpdatePublishingDestination. This blinds the security team to GuardDuty findings.
